title: Jacobi Symbol and QR for Composite Moduli
description: Extends quadratic reciprocity from the Legendre symbol (prime moduli) to the Jacobi symbol (composite odd moduli), formalizing the generalized reciprocity law J(m,n)·J(n,m) = (-1)^((m-1)/2·(n-1)/2) for coprime odd m,n.

keyInsights.title: Jacobi Symbol Extends Legendre
keyInsights.description: The Jacobi symbol J(a,n) = ∏(a/pᵢ)^eᵢ generalizes the Legendre symbol to composite odd moduli, preserving multiplicativity but losing the 'QR iff symbol = 1' equivalence.

keyInsights.title: Reciprocity Generalizes
keyInsights.description: Quadratic reciprocity J(m,n)·J(n,m) = (-1)^((m-1)/2·(n-1)/2) holds for all coprime odd m,n > 1, not just primes. The proof reduces to the prime case via multiplicativity.

keyInsights.title: One-Way Detection
keyInsights.description: J(a,n) = -1 guarantees a is a non-residue mod n, but J(a,n) = 1 for composite n does NOT guarantee a is a QR. This asymmetry is why primality testing via Jacobi symbols needs care.

openQuestion: Can we formalize alternative QR proof approaches, including extensions to composite moduli?
